steps: Click the visible wrapper [aria-label="发送图片"]
Call chooser.setFiles with the absolute local path

known_failures: Calling setInputFiles on the controller locator is unsupported.
Clicking the accessibility snapshot's inner Choose File button can time out because it is hidden.
Clicking generic text 发送图片 can time out because the actionable element is the aria-label wrapper.
Clicking the hidden input with force may not produce a filechooser event.
permissions: The Chrome extension may require Allow access to file URLs for local uploads.
profiles.evidence: Live image upload completed in an authenticated BOSS chat; image preview and delivery status were observed.
